name: Raw | Original Tips 50ct
description: RAW rolling papers are pure and less processed than traditional papers. For many die-hard hand rollers, RAW is the only way to go. Raw tips are made with special long fiber, dense natural paper. These tips will keep their shape and not get soggy or dissolve like other paper tips. Putting a tip at the mouthpiece when hand-rolling makes for a clean draw and bigger hits. It doesn't matter whether you call them tips, chills, scrolls, crutches or filters, they make smoking way better.
